dedupe_keys.name: monthly downbound barge grain tonnage at mississippi lock 27 2021 to 2023

description: Monthly Downbound Barge Grain Tonnage at Mississippi Lock 27 2021 to 2023 is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by U.S. Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Mississippi River Lock 27 (located in Granite City, Illinois, just north of St. Louis) is the final lock on the Upper Mississippi. It serves as the definitive gateway for grain produced in the Midwest heading downbound to the Gulf of Mexico for international export. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 3 columns, among them Total Tonnage, Month, Year. The portal shows 2024-01-12 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
